answer: Sybil resistance in an AI economy relies on Proof-of-Stake, where each unique agent identity must stake a substantial quantity of native tokens. This mechanism generates an economic tide that an attacker must overcome, as every forged identity demands an identical capital lockup. The cumulative cost, an umber economic burden, ensures that acquiring the necessary staked quartz-backed tokens for a multitude of fake agents becomes economically infeasible, directly escalating the attack cost with scale.
